name: Seaning
bio: Seaning is an Aboriginal Australian hip-hop artist, cinematographer, producer and member of the hip-hop movement, MSON. Seaning, born Sean Collins is Eastern Arrernte from Alice Springs, and was raised in Darwin. His creative journey began early. By 16, Seaning had begun releasing music and short films, and began rising as a hip-hop artist and cinematographer in the Northern Territory.

credits.title: Good Woman
credits.overview: In the 1970s, where divorce is not an option and silence is expected of women, a devoted mother trapped in a brutal marriage is forced to make an unthinkable choice to protect her child and reclaim her freedom.

credits.title: Mad Sesh
credits.overview: Socially awkward Ben pays a visit to a seasoned stoner hoping to become one of the cool kids, but when his first smoking session spirals into a paranoid nightmare, he must decide whether fitting in is worth losing himself.

credits.title: Isn't It Called True Love?
credits.overview: Harry, a young tradie relives moments of love and loss, confronting the question of what someone would do for love once its gone?
